result.stdout:
USAGE:
  cosmosdbshell [options] [-c|-k <command>...]

OPTIONS:
  --color-system, --cs <n>         Color system: 0=off, 1=standard, 2=true color (default: 2).
  -c <command>...                  Execute the specified command, then exit.
  -k <command>...                  Execute the specified command, then keep the shell running.
  --clear-history, --clearhistory  Clears command history and exits.
  --connect <endpoint>             The endpoint URL or connection string to connect to.
  --connect-mode <direct|gateway>  Connection mode: 'direct' (default) or 'gateway'
  --connect-tenant <id>            The Entra ID tenant ID to authenticate against at startup.
  --connect-hint <hint>            Login hint for browser authentication at startup.
  --connect-authority-host <url>   The authority host URL at startup (default: https://login.microsoftonline.com/).
  --connect-managed-identity <id>  The client ID of a user-assigned managed identity at startup.
  --connect-subscription <id>      Azure subscription ID for ARM database and container operations at startup.
  --connect-resource-group <name>  Azure resource group name for ARM database and container operations at startup.
  --mcp [<port>]                   Enable MCP HTTP server. Optionally specify a port with --mcp <port>; default is 6128.
  --lsp                            Enable Language Server Protocol (LSP) server for editor integration
  --verbose                        Print full exception details instead of only the message.
  --help, -h, -?                   Show this help text and exit.
  --version                        Show product version and exit.

NOTES:
  Everything after -c / -k (or /c, /k) is taken as the command (no quoting needed). App-level options must come before -c / -k.
